sentences.quote: Magda Chambriard (born 1957) became Petrobras CEO in May 2024, the second woman to ever lead the company. She is notably the sixth CEO in five years, a reflection of Brazil's political volatility
sentences.text: Magda Chambriard, born in 1957, became CEO of Petroleo Brasileiro SA in May 2024, only the second woman to lead the company and its sixth chief executive in five years amid Brazil's political volatility around the firm.

A civil engineering graduate of UFRJ (1979) with a master's in chemical engineering (1989), she spent 22 years at Petrobras from 1980 in oil production and reservoir engineering, then served as Director-General of the National Petroleum Agency from 2012 to 2016 under Dilma Rousseff, later working as an energy consultant and joining Lula's 2022 transition team.

A Lula appointee with a contract extended through April 2027, she is pursuing aggressive pre-salt production growth, revived refineries and fertilizer plants, Amazon frontier drilling and net-zero carbon by 2050.
